{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Emerald green wool crepe pencil skirt, straight cut, midi length, hex #50C878.
Cream silk-blend blouse, relaxed fit, long length, hex #FFFDD0.
Charcoal grey unstructured blazer, boxy cut, hip length, hex #36454F.
Oiled-leather Chelsea boots, pointed toe, ankle length, hex #2F2F2F.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance for an autumn morning in the office while preparing for possible rain. The wool skirt provides structure and warmth, while the silk blouse adds a touch of softness suitable for daylight hours. A waterproofed leather boot choice ensures comfort during walking without sacrificing the neat business aesthetic required by the dress code. The muted color palette keeps the look professional yet seasonally appropriate for early fall."}
